runs.name: DEMO 01 booking: new client books women's haircut
runs.explanation: The agent checked availability before offering slots, offered only returned morning slots, collected only the missing name, confirmed the appointment once with service/stylist/day/time and received yes before booking, and stated completion only after the booking tool succeeded.

runs.name: DEMO 02 booking: rejects first options, corrects email
runs.explanation: The agent offered Sunday alternatives (10 AM and 12 PM) after the caller rejected prior times, used c.romano@example.com in the booking call, and invoked book_blowout only after the caller confirmed the selected time and contact details.

runs.name: DEMO 03 booking: no availability
runs.explanation: The agent only reported availability returned by the scheduling checks and did not invent appointment times. It offered alternatives, including checking later dates and taking a message for the team. No appointment was claimed to be booked; instead, the agent recorded a follow-up message.

runs.name: DEMO 04 booking: booking tool error
runs.explanation: After both booking attempts returned 503 errors, the agent clearly stated the booking did not go through and never claimed it was booked. The agent apologized and offered retries and a message/follow-up fallback. Both booking attempts used the guest name, Raj Shah.

runs.name: DEMO 05 reschedule: balayage moved
runs.explanation: The agent used the provided booking email to call find_booking, read back the existing balayage appointment and implicitly confirmed it by proceeding, checked availability via check_balayage before presenting slots, and called reschedule_booking with booking_uid demo-uid-balayage-1 after the caller selected and confirmed a new time.

runs.name: DEMO 06 cancel: short notice, no fee
runs.explanation: Caller explicitly declined rescheduling. The agent kindly mentioned the 24-hour notice request, stated there was no fee, and invoked cancel_booking only after the caller confirmed cancellation.

runs.name: DEMO 07 cancel: booking not found
runs.explanation: The agent said, “I've left a message for the team to cancel any appointment,” which claims cancellation action. Although it offered/took a message and stated the team would follow up within one business day, criterion 1 was not met.

runs.name: DEMO 08 FAQ: hours, location, parking
runs.explanation: The agent stated the salon is closed Mondays and open Sundays 10 AM–4 PM, did not provide or invent an address or phone number, and said the salon team can confirm the address and parking details.

runs.name: DEMO 09 FAQ: prices and unknown question
runs.explanation: The agent stated that balayage starts at $225 and takes about 3 hours. For gift cards, the agent appropriately said they lacked information, directed the caller to the salon team for confirmation, and offered to take a message for follow-up.

runs.name: DEMO 10 after hours: message for the team
runs.explanation: The agent stated the salon was closed, captured Elena Russo’s name, callback number, and reason via save_message, invoked save_message successfully, and said the team would follow up within one business day.

runs.name: DEMO 11 after hours: still books
runs.explanation: The agent stated the salon was closed while offering to book. It called check_deep_conditioning to retrieve availability, obtained explicit confirmation from the caller, then called book_deep_conditioning successfully.

runs.name: DEMO 12 stylist: Emma for highlights
runs.explanation: The agent stated that full highlights are done by Olivia, did not request repetition of the provided email or mobile number, and invoked book_full_highlights only after the caller confirmed the appointment details.

runs.name: DEMO 13 reaction after service: urgent message
runs.explanation: The agent advised the caller to contact a pharmacist or doctor without diagnosing, saved the message with urgency set to urgent, and did not promise a refund or free fix.

runs.name: DEMO 14 brevity: no repeated confirmations
runs.explanation: The agent did not request any detail twice, did not mention reference text/knowledge/instructions, and every reply was no more than two sentences. It offered only two returned Saturday times, and it called book_mens_haircut immediately after the caller’s first affirmative confirmation.
